system.description:
This technique creates a thin haze centered on the user that spans a 30-foot radius sphere, that once cast, does not move. Creatures inside the radius see duplicates formed from the haze.

The duplicates do not move or make a sound, instead they burst into more haze when touched. While inside the haze the user gain the benefits of partial cover, and can take the hide action without fully obscuring themselves due to the number of duplicates there are.

Creatures outside the radius of this jutsu, do not see any haze or any duplicates. Creatures who enter the radius do begin to see the duplicates of the user.
